data.title: Arsenal vs Lille Prediction: Champions League Preview | Opta Analyst
data.content:
The Gunners have a win probability of 71%, compared to just 11.4% for their French visitors. The draw is considered an 11.4% possibility.

## Arsenal vs Lille Predicted Lineups

Arsenal: David Raya, Ben White, Ezri Konsa, Gabriel Magalhães, Piero Hincapié, Declan Rice, Myles Lewis-Skelly, Bukayo Saka, Martin Ødegaard, Eberechi Eze, Viktor Gyökeres

Head coach: Mikel Arteta [...] They will be back on home turf on Tuesday, and Arsenal have an excellent defensive record in the Champions League since the start of 2025-26.

Indeed, of all teams to participate in each of the last two editions, Arsenal rank first on a per-game basis for goals conceded (0.44), expected goals against (0.86), and shots on target faced (2.9), as well as having the highest clean sheet percentage (63% – 10/16). [...] Mbappé is suspended for Lille but would have missed out anyway with an ankle injury, while former Rangers striker Hamza Igamane (knee) is out for the foreseeable future.

## Arsenal vs Lille Head-to-Head

Arsenal have faced 10 different French teams in European competition, but this contest will mark their first-ever meeting against Lille.
